candidate.time_stop_rationale: time stop matches session-cycle risk where overnight/succeeding session negation invalidates momentum
candidate.turnover_cost_budget: natural multi-hour continuation increases expected move so fewer trades with longer holds aim to dominate verified costs
candidate.why_distinct: differs from intraday scalps by owning multi-session continuation and using session-overlap volume as the causal payer rather than microstructure flow
